type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [6, 51, 21, 17, 59, 58, 56, 23, 36] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt
print (sumOf tree)
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT tree)

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt

  match t:

    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [1, 49, 28, 50, 34] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsOf k tree) [1, 35, 16])
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf tree)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

let decodeLine line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [27, 50, 46, 51, 45] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = [6, 9, 53, 39, 42, 25, 7] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsOf k root) [6, 8, 47])
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT root)
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf root)
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))

    case Num n: n

    case Neg a: -(calc a)

  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

print (List.map both [1, 8, 7])
let swapSum pairs =
  let (a, b) = List.head pairs |> Option.withDefault (0, 0)
  let (b, a) = (a + 1, b + 1)
  List.map (fun (a, b) -> a * b) pairs |> List.map (fun x -> x + a - b)
print (swapSum [(4, 1), (6, 3)])
let scale n = n * 2
let picked =

    case Some scale: scale + 1
    case None: 0

let mut hits = 0
let record x =
  hits <- hits + 1
  x * 2
let summarize xs =
  let mut lo = 1000
  let mut hi = -1000
  let mut total = 0
  let visit x =
    lo <- min lo x
    hi <- max hi x
    total <- total + x
  List.iter visit xs
  f"lo={lo} hi={hi} total={total}"
print (summarize [45, 19, 55, 58])
let doubled = [45, 19, 55, 58] |> List.map record
print f"{doubled} after {hits} calls"

  let go twice = twice + 1
  List.map (fun x -> go (twice x)) xs

let (|Low|Mid|High|) n =
  let scaled = n * 2
  if scaled < 1 then Low
  else if scaled < 29 then Mid
  else High
let describe n =
  match n:
    case Low: "low"
    case Mid if n % 2 == 0: "mid-even"
    case Mid: "mid"
    case High: "high"
